key: My apologies; Miss Shelly Citra is currently not accepting challengers.
en: My apologies; Miss Shelly Citra is currently not accepting challengers.
ja: 申し訳ございません、シェリー・シトラ様は現在挑戦者を受け付けておりません。

key: Normally I would tell challengers exactly where she is or when she'd be available, but I'm afraid I don't actually know.
en: Normally I would tell challengers exactly where she is or when she'd be available, but I'm afraid I don't actually know.
ja: 普段でしたら、彼女の居場所や対応可能な時間を挑戦者の方にお伝えするのですが、あいにく私自身、存じ上げないのです。

key: She just up and left one day-- after your challenge in fact, now that I think of it-- and has sent no word since.
en: She just up and left one day-- after your challenge in fact, now that I think of it-- and has sent no word since.
ja: ある日突然出ていかれまして――そういえば、あなたの挑戦の後のことでしたね――それ以来、何の連絡もございません。

key: Not very becoming of a Gym Leader, but I suppose she is just a child.
en: Not very becoming of a Gym Leader, but I suppose she is just a child.
ja: ジムリーダーらしからぬことですが、まだ子供ですから、仕方ないのかもしれません。

key: CAIN: I didn't realize she saw everything--
en: CAIN: I didn't realize she saw everything--
ja: カイン: 彼女がすべてを見ていたなんて、気づかなかったよ――

key: I am so, so sorry.
en: I am so, so sorry.
ja: 本当に、本当にごめん。

key: CAIN: I'm just gonna...
en: CAIN: I'm just gonna...
ja: カイン: とりあえず、僕は……

key: Go...
en: Go...
ja: 行くよ……

key: For now...
en: For now...
ja: 今のところは……

key: CAL: ...
en: CAL: ...

key: Even I can't believe she knew the guy too.
en: Even I can't believe she knew the guy too.
ja: 俺だって、あいつまであの男を知ってたとは信じられねえよ。

key: What are the fucking odds?
en: What are the fucking odds?
ja: いったいどんな確率だってんだ?

key: Well, Victoria's cleaning her up and taking care of her now.
en: Well, Victoria's cleaning her up and taking care of her now.
ja: まあ、今はヴィクトリアが世話をして、面倒見てくれてる。

key: I just wish there was something I could do.
en: I just wish there was something I could do.
ja: 俺にも何かできることがありゃいいんだが。

key: How does anyone expect a kid to deal with all this?
en: How does anyone expect a kid to deal with all this?
ja: こんなこと、子供にどう対処しろってんだ?

key: If she's stressed to the point of getting sick...
en: If she's stressed to the point of getting sick...
ja: 具合が悪くなるほどストレスためこんでるなら……

key: ...You think she needs a doctor?
en: ...You think she needs a doctor?
ja: ……医者が要ると思うか?

key: There's one nearby, right?
en: There's one nearby, right?
ja: この近くにいたよな?

key: I saw a sign for it in this ward.
en: I saw a sign for it in this ward.
ja: この区で看板見かけたぞ。

key: Dr. Connor or whatever.
en: Dr. Connor or whatever.
ja: コナー先生とかなんとか。

key: Hey, you mind going to ask if he'll see Shelly?
en: Hey, you mind going to ask if he'll see Shelly?
ja: なあ、シェリーを診てくれるか聞きに行ってくれねえか?

key: Maybe that's just what she needs after all this.
en: Maybe that's just what she needs after all this.
ja: こんなことがあった後だ、それが必要なのかもな。

key: CAL: You mind going to ask if Dr. Connor or whatever will see Shelly?
en: CAL: You mind going to ask if Dr. Connor or whatever will see Shelly?
ja: コナー先生とかなんとかに、シェリーを診てくれるか聞きに行ってくれねえか?

key: My apologies; Miss Shelly Citra is currently unavailable.
en: My apologies; Miss Shelly Citra is currently unavailable.
ja: 申し訳ございません、シェリー・シトラ様は現在、対応いたしかねます。

key: CAL: The others are upstairs.
en: CAL: The others are upstairs.
ja: 他の連中は上にいるぜ。

key: There's another kid here too-- got here around the same time as that jackass.
en: There's another kid here too-- got here around the same time as that jackass.
ja: ここにはもう一人子供がいてな――あのろくでなしと同じ頃に来たんだ。

key: But at least he had some basic fucking decency.
en: But at least he had some basic fucking decency.
ja: でも少なくとも、あいつには最低限の分別ってもんがあったぜ。
